children.name: Kiggelaria africana
children.description: Note: Sleumer (in Polhill, Fl. Trop. E. Africa, Flacourtiaceae:. 31. 1975) and Killick (in Ross, Fl. Southern Africa 22: 62. 1976) both indicated material in LINN as the type but none of the four sheets there is original material for the name. Barrie (in Jarvis & al., Regnum Veg. 127: 59. 1993) therefore designated Herb. Clifford: 462, Kiggelaria 1 A (BM) as lectotype, but this choice is pre-dated by that of Stearn.
